question: Floating in orbit, how much bone mass can an astronaut lose in one month?
answer: Astronauts lose 1–2% of bone mass every month in orbit. That is over 10 times faster than osteoporosis on Earth. With no weight pushing on them, their bones thin, mostly in the legs.
move: Bone stays only where load is felt.
